plain.why: M5 is distinguisher-or-drop. This is a proposed kill test, not a logical qubit.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: CPU / non-symplectic 3D EM tokamak solves. Distinguisher: GPU implicit symplectic CN-FDTD. Solver, not controller.
cards.disputer: A solver is not a plant attach until it speaks a lab command set.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: triangular 6.6.6 color code and rotated surface code qubit counts. Distinguisher: 4.8.8 brickwork density at fixed distance.
cards.disputer: Density is not non-Abelian decoding.

plain.why: Bus B cost. Color codes also give a path to transversal T.
plain.limit: Circuit-level sim, superconducting-targeted.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: state-of-the-art finite-length qLDPC. Distinguisher: girth ≥ 6 quasi-dyadic CSS.
cards.disputer: A nicer Tanner graph is not a logical qubit on a machine.

plain.core: Quasi-dyadic CSS qLDPC with girth at least 6, competitive at finite length.

plain.limit: Monte Carlo, not a processor.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: stochastic Pauli qLDPC thresholds. Distinguisher: coherent/local-channel diamond-distance decay. Theory; G5 caps analog C at 3; E-QEC already C4.
cards.disputer: Code-capacity coherent thresholds are not a device-level non-Abelian decoder.

plain.core: qLDPC codes have a nonzero threshold against local coherent noise, not only stochastic Pauli noise.
plain.why: The Bus B error layer is qLDPC / surface code. Coherent errors are the realistic noise.
plain.limit: Proof, not hardware.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: TCV standard discharge-prep shaping. Distinguisher: inverse-GS NN vs classical recipe. Hardware class is tokamak (G5 honest). Preprint so C stays C4.
cards.disputer: A shaping win without real-time shape feedback is not yet a disruption-rate win.

plain.core: A neural inverse Grad–Shafranov map shaped plasma on TCV better than the usual prep recipe.
plain.why: Bus A is diagnostics in, actuators out. This is that interface on a real machine.
plain.limit: Preprint; no explicit real-time shape feedback; not M2-complete.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: full-distribution survival / DSM. Distinguisher: finite-horizon alarm vs remaining-lifetime. Preprint; G5 caps analog C at 3, E-RL already C4.
cards.disputer: Loop cannot close inside tearing / Alfvén times if I/O is a quantum job queue.

plain.core: Score disruption risk inside a finite horizon, not the whole remaining shot.
plain.why: M2 is a disruption-relevant metric. This is a Bus A attach language.
plain.limit: Preprint, not a beat-the-lab-baseline shot.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: PCS latency. Distinguisher: FPGA quantized RPNN vs software inference. Not a quantum-in-the-loop claim.
cards.disputer: If the loop cannot close inside instability growth time, the module is offline only.

plain.core: Quantized recurrent net on an FPGA estimates plasma state inside PCS latency.
plain.why: Latency is the E-RL kill threshold. This is how Bus A stays classical-in-the-loop.
plain.limit: Inference hardware, not a published disruption-rate win.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: Solov’ev / mesh Grad–Shafranov. Distinguisher: residual of GS PDE.
cards.disputer: A solver is not a controller.

plain.why: Equilibrium is the state Bus A acts on.
plain.limit: Fixed-boundary, not shot-validated EFIT.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: G-EQDSK grids. Distinguisher: reconstructible MXH–Chebyshev vs lab-specific files.
cards.disputer: A database is not a plant attach until it speaks a lab command set.

plain.why: M8 needs a controller a SPARC-class team can run without one lab’s file conventions.
plain.limit: Fixed-boundary; does not close a shot loop.

cards.gateNote: Named baseline: one-gate-at-a-time lattice surgery. Distinguisher: multi-gate flow + runtime T scheduling.
cards.disputer: Abelian surgery density ≠ non-Abelian decoding.

plain.why: Cheaper Bus B wrapper around the surface-code layer.
plain.limit: Compiler paper, not hardware.

plain.why: A qLDPC-class alternative sitting next to the surface-code default.
plain.limit: Relaxed locality is an assumption, not a measured threshold.
